entities.summary: Ivan Hryhorovych Kyrylenko is a Ukrainian politician and from 2007 till December 2011 faction leader of Yulia Tymoshenko Bloc in the Ukrainian Parliament. Kyrylenko held the position of the Minister of Agriculture from 2000 to 2002 and the Vice-Prime Minister of Ukraine from 2002 to 2005. During the periods he was not in these offices, he served as an MP since 1995.
